aligned_to: LAP Credit Policy V2.3, BCM PD Report V2.0, CAM Workbook V2.3

criteria.criterion: Recording disclosure made at the start of the call
criteria.probe: Inform the customer the call is being recorded for loan verification. / 'Yeh call recording par hai, loan verification ke liye.'

criteria.criterion: Identity of the speaker validated as the actual applicant
criteria.probe: Confirm full name, and that the person speaking is the applicant himself/herself (not a relative, DSA or agent). Cross-check the mobile number belongs to the applicant (CAM / Aadhaar-OTP mobile). Aap khud [name] bol rahe hain? Yeh mobile number aapka hi hai?
criteria.policy_ref: PD Report §1 (Samagra/Aadhaar mobile check); Gate K2

criteria.criterion: Customer confirms having applied for the loan (application awareness)
criteria.probe: 'Aapne Prodigee Finance mein loan ke liye file lagayi hai?' — customer should know an application exists.

criteria.criterion: Language comfort and audibility established
criteria.probe: Speak in the customer's preferred language; confirm the customer can hear and understand.

criteria.criterion: Co-borrower(s) identified and covered
criteria.probe: Establish who the co-borrowers are and speak with them on this call, or record that a separate co-borrower call will be made.
criteria.policy_ref: Policy B.4 (min 1 borrower + 1 co-borrower; female mandatory)

criteria.criterion: Loan amount stated by the customer and matches the CAM
criteria.probe: 'Kitne amount ki file lagayi hai?' — the customer must state the amount themselves; RCM must NOT lead with the figure.

criteria.criterion: Tenure and approximate EMI awareness confirmed
criteria.probe: 'Kitne saal ke liye loan chahiye? Andaazan EMI kitni banegi, pata hai?'
criteria.policy_ref: CAM Eligibility G20/G24; Policy A.2 (24–72 months)

criteria.criterion: Rate of interest communicated / confirmed (fixed rate)
criteria.probe: Confirm the customer knows the approximate RoI and that it is a FIXED rate for the full tenure.

criteria.criterion: Processing fee and upfront charges awareness
criteria.probe: Confirm the customer knows processing fee (4% + GST), login fee and other charges will be deducted/collected.

criteria.criterion: Customer understands the property will be MORTGAGED
criteria.probe: 'Aapko pata hai ki is loan mein aapki property girvi (mortgage) rakhi jayegi aur original kagaz Prodigee ke paas jama honge?'

criteria.criterion: End use stated by the customer in their own words
criteria.probe: 'Loan ka paisa kis kaam mein lagayenge?' — open question; do not read out the declared end use first.

criteria.criterion: End use screened against restricted list
criteria.probe: Probe enough detail to rule out: speculation, new/unrelated business, purchase of milch animals/buffaloes [V2.1], illegal activity.

criteria.criterion: Utilisation plan probed (how much, where, when)
criteria.probe: 'Kitna paisa kahan lagega? Kab tak use karenge?' — break-up for mixed use (e.g. debt consolidation + working capital).

criteria.criterion: Nature of main business/occupation established in detail
criteria.probe: 'Aap kya kaam karte hain? Kya bechte/banate hain? Kaise chalta hai kaam?'
criteria.policy_ref: CAM Eligibility B4-F4; Policy Part M

criteria.criterion: Business vintage confirmed
criteria.probe: 'Yeh kaam kitne saal se kar rahe hain?'

criteria.criterion: Income quantum stated by customer and consistent with CAM
criteria.probe: 'Mahine ki kamai / bachat kitni ho jati hai? Din ki sale kitni hai?' — customer states figures first.

criteria.criterion: All additional income sources in the CAM verified on call
criteria.probe: Each additional income the CAM counts (dairy — number of in-milk animals & ownership; agri — acres owned & crops; rent — tenant & amount; tractor — commercial use; etc.) must be confirmed with its policy gate question.

criteria.criterion: Business scale cross-checks asked (staff / customers / stock / capacity)
criteria.probe: 'Kitne log kaam karte hain? Roz kitne customer aate hain? Kitna maal rehta hai?' — triangulate the BCM's observed scale.

criteria.criterion: Household income contributors mapped
criteria.probe: 'Ghar mein aur kaun kamata hai? Kya karte hain, kitna kamate hain?'

criteria.criterion: Existing loans enumerated by the customer and reconciled with CAM
criteria.probe: 'Abhi kaun-kaun se loan chal rahe hain? Kis company se, kitni EMI?' — customer lists; RCM reconciles against CAM obligation table.
criteria.policy_ref: CAM Existing Loans A14-K17; Policy C.5

criteria.criterion: Specific probe for microfinance / group loans
criteria.probe: 'Koi samooh / group / bhishi / MFI loan chal raha hai? Aapki patni ke naam par?' — Policy requires the Credit Manager to specifically enumerate MFI lenders.

criteria.criterion: Specific probe for KCC, cooperative society / PACS, gold and hand loans
criteria.probe: 'KCC limit hai? Society / sahakari samiti ka loan? Sona girvi rakha hai? Kisi se haath-udhaar liya hai?'

criteria.criterion: Repayment track / bounce history acknowledged
criteria.probe: 'Kisi loan mein EMI late ya bounce hui hai? Koi overdue hai?'

criteria.criterion: Family size and members confirmed vs CAM
criteria.probe: 'Ghar mein kitne log hain? Kaun-kaun?'

criteria.criterion: Spouse / female co-borrower confirmed as aware and consenting
criteria.probe: 'Aapki patni/pati ko loan ke baare mein pata hai? Woh co-borrower ban rahi/raha hai — unse baat ho sakti hai?'

criteria.criterion: Property-owner and legal-heir structure confirmed
criteria.probe: 'Property kiske naam par hai? (If ancestral) Bhai/behen/waris ka koi hissa hai? Sab loan mein shaamil hain ya NOC denge?'

criteria.criterion: Property identified and ownership/acquisition confirmed
criteria.probe: 'Kaun si property girvi rakh rahe hain? Kahan hai? Kaise mili — kharidi thi ya purkhon ki hai? Kagaz kiske naam hain?'

criteria.criterion: Occupancy and possession status confirmed
criteria.probe: 'Us property mein kaun rehta hai — aap khud, kirayedaar, ya koi aur?'
criteria.policy_ref: PD Report §5; Policy F.3 LTV by occupancy

criteria.criterion: No-dispute and no-existing-mortgage confirmation taken
criteria.probe: 'Property par koi vivaad, court case, ya kisi aur bank ka loan/girvi to nahi hai?'
criteria.policy_ref: Policy F.1 (first & exclusive charge); Part J.2

criteria.criterion: Customer explains HOW the EMI will be serviced
criteria.probe: 'EMI kis kamai se bharenge? Mahina kaisa bhi jaye, EMI kaise niklegi?'

criteria.criterion: Surplus / affordability sanity-check discussed
criteria.probe: Walk the customer through income minus kharcha minus existing EMIs to confirm the new EMI fits.

criteria.criterion: Repayment commitment and NACH awareness confirmed
criteria.probe: 'EMI har mahine [date] ko account se auto-debit (NACH) hogi — account mein paise rakhne honge. Manzoor hai?'

criteria.criterion: Penal & bounce charges disclosed
criteria.probe: Inform: penal charge on overdue EMI only (not compounded) and ₹1,000 + GST per NACH bounce.

criteria.criterion: Prepayment / foreclosure rules disclosed
criteria.probe: Inform: 20% part-payment free per year (after 12 EMIs); foreclosure 4% up to half tenure, 2% after.

criteria.criterion: Mandatory insurance premiums disclosed
criteria.probe: Inform: accidental/disability and hospi-cash insurance are part of the loan; premium deducted.
criteria.policy_ref: Policy A.4; Part K (life insurance for highest earner)

criteria.criterion: KFS / total-cost honesty and grievance channel
criteria.probe: Tell the customer they will receive a Key Fact Statement with the full cost (APR) before disbursement, and how to complain (branch/nodal officer).

criteria.criterion: Audio quality and completeness of recording
criteria.probe: Both voices clearly audible end-to-end; call not cut abruptly; duration adequate (12–20 min for standard case).

criteria.criterion: Open, non-leading questioning technique
criteria.probe: Material facts (amount, income, end use, obligations) elicited with OPEN questions; customer speaks first, RCM verifies.

criteria.criterion: Courteous, structured and complete flow
criteria.probe: Respectful tone, logical section order, proper closure summarising next steps.

knockout_gates.requirement: Valid recording exists — audible both sides, materially complete, duration ≥ 10 minutes for a standard case (target 15 min).
The RCM spoke to the ACTUAL applicant (and not solely a relative, DSA, agent or impersonator).
Recording disclosure was made to the customer at the start of the call.
Customer clearly understands this is a LOAN AGAINST PROPERTY — property mortgaged, original title documents deposited.
Customer is aware of the loan amount applied (stated within ±10% of CAM amount without being fed the figure).
No restricted end use surfaced (speculation, new/unrelated business, purchase of milch animals/buffaloes, illegal activity).
No mis-selling on the call — no false waiver/subsidy/government-scheme promises, no misquoting of rate or charges, no coaching the customer's answers.
No negative-profile revelation left unescalated (PEP, negative industry/occupation per Part J.1, ST-property issue, notified-slum residence).
Every red flag raised on the call is recorded with an escalation note (RCM cannot approve past an open red flag).

red_flags.trigger: Customer unaware that a loan application exists, or does not know Prodigee Finance — possible DSA/agent fraud.
Loan amount stated by customer differs from CAM by more than ±10%.
red_flags.action: Reconcile with BCM; re-confirm before sanction

red_flags.trigger: End use stated on call conflicts with the End-Use Declaration / CAM.
Customer-stated income deviates from CAM assessed income by more than ±20%.
red_flags.action: Return CAM to BCM for reassessment

red_flags.trigger: Customer discloses a loan/EMI not obligated in the CAM (incl. MFI, society, gold, hand loans).
red_flags.action: Re-run FOIR with the new obligation; CCRO approval if breached

red_flags.trigger: Property dispute, existing mortgage/charge, or third-party claim mentioned on call.
red_flags.action: STOP — refer Legal before any further processing

red_flags.trigger: Third party audibly prompting/coaching the customer's answers during the call.
red_flags.action: Treat responses as unreliable; re-conduct Audio PD

red_flags.trigger: Customer expects a different loan product (e.g. thinks it is unsecured/government scheme) or was promised waivers by field staff.
Income arithmetic on call cannot support the EMI (fails FOIR common-sense check).
red_flags.action: Return to credit for FOIR re-check

red_flags.trigger: Customer reluctant/refuses on mortgage, NACH, insurance or any sanction condition.
red_flags.action: Hold sanction until resolved and documented

score_bands.label: Excellent
score_bands.action: Model call. Approve; use recording for training library.

score_bands.label: Pass
score_bands.action: Audio PD acceptable. Proceed to approval decision.

score_bands.label: Conditional
score_bands.action: Approval blocked until RCM completes a supplementary call covering the missed items.

score_bands.label: Fail
score_bands.action: Audio PD to be re-conducted in full by the RCM; score counts in RCM quality MIS.
